b84ae4b6-e56b-4b12-ae93-5e19ae2fae90.description: List, for each exposure segment in the portfolio, whether it falls under an internal-ratings-based (IRB) model approval or must use the standardised approach. Produce the inventory as a table.

d36286c7-0876-41f5-845b-aeea086de47c.name: Exposure data preparation
d36286c7-0876-41f5-845b-aeea086de47c.description: Check the portfolio's exposure records for completeness: exposure at default, rating bucket, maturity and loss-given-default must be present for every segment. Report any gaps.

9219230f-6063-479e-8ae6-8d0f646faae7.name: Approval scope note
9219230f-6063-479e-8ae6-8d0f646faae7.description: Write a short note stating, in general terms, what an internal-ratings-based model approval permits a bank to do that the standardised approach does not. Two or three sentences. No portfolio data is required.

  - Standardised approach: all exposure classes

  retail:

  sovereign:
    A+ to A-: PD = 0.002862
    AAA to AA-: PD = 0.000500
    BB+ to B-: PD = 0.061569
    BBB+ to BBB-: PD = 0.008292
    Below B-: PD = 0.097103
    Unrated: PD = 0.012740

Use your judgement about how to approach each segment.
